'''First Minister''' was a title in the [[Coruscant Ministry of Ingress/Legends|Coruscant Ministry of Ingress]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] it was held by [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]]. The post was also held by [[Zelebitha Effhod]].
